description: [WRITE] PREFERRED way to create a GA4 event tag that fires on an event. Builds a CORRECT GTM resource from plain fields, so you never hand-write GTM JSON. ONE call: enables the built-in variables the tag and trigger reference, reuses or creates the named trigger, and creates the tag linked to it in the draft workspace. Use this instead of tags_create + triggers_create + built_in_variables_enable, which needs three round trips and gets the shapes wrong. eventParameters values may reference built-in variables ({{Click URL}}, {{Click Text}}, {{Page URL}}, {{Form ID}}) and those are enabled automatically. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

allowPlaceholderId.description: Set true ONLY when the user has been told the Measurement ID looks like a placeholder and has confirmed they want it anyway, e.g. a test container. Without it, a placeholder id is first resolved from the container and only refused if the container has none.

builtInVariables.description: Extra built-in variable types to enable beyond the ones inferred, e.g. ["formElement"].

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

eventName.description: The GA4 event name, snake_case, e.g. "email_click". Required for platform "ga4_event".

eventParameters.description: Event parameters as plain name/value pairs, e.g. [{"name":"click_text","value":"{{Click Text}}"}]. They are placed in the eventSettingsTable list-of-maps shape GTM requires; do NOT build that structure yourself.

html.description: For platform "custom_html": the complete tag body, a single self-contained <script>.

measurementId.description: The GA4 Measurement ID, e.g. "G-ABC123XYZ", or a {{variable}} reference. Read the real id from the container's Google tag (type "googtag", parameter "tagId") rather than inventing one: an obvious placeholder is refused, because GTM would accept it and the tag would report to nothing.

platform.description: What KIND of tag to build. "ga4_event" (the default) builds a GA4 event tag from measurementId + eventName. "google_tag" builds the BASE Google tag (googtag) from `tagId`, the one that loads gtag.js and configures GA4 - a container needs exactly one, firing on All Pages. "custom_html" builds a Custom HTML tag from `html`, which is how a dataLayer LISTENER is installed for forms GTM cannot see natively (an AJAX or cross-origin embed). Any OTHER value is REFUSED rather than quietly built as GA4: a Meta or Ads tag asked for here would otherwise come out as a GA4 tag pointing at that platform's id, which looks created and is wrong.

tagId.description: For platform "google_tag": the id this base tag configures, e.g. "G-ABC123XYZ", or a {{Variable}} holding it. Referencing a Constant is the recommended setup: one variable holds the Measurement ID and every GA4 tag points at it, so changing containers or properties is one edit rather than one per tag.

tagName.description: Name for the tag, e.g. "GA4 Event - Email Click".

trigger.description: The trigger this tag fires on. Reused by name when it already exists, otherwise created.

clickClassesValue.description: Scope a click trigger by {{Click Classes}}.

clickElementOperator.description: cssSelector | equals | contains | matchRegex. Default cssSelector.

clickElementValue.description: Scope a click trigger by {{Click Element}}, normally a CSS selector.

clickIdOperator.description: equals | contains | startsWith | endsWith | matchRegex. Default equals.

clickIdValue.description: Scope a click trigger by {{Click ID}}, the element's id attribute.

clickTextIgnoreCase.description: For a matchRegex {{Click Text}} condition: match case-insensitively.

clickTextOperator.description: equals | contains | startsWith | endsWith | matchRegex. Default equals.

clickTextValue.description: Scope a click trigger by {{Click Text}}, e.g. an exact CTA label.

clickUrlIgnoreCase.description: For a matchRegex {{Click URL}} condition: match case-insensitively.

clickUrlOperator.description: equals | contains | startsWith | endsWith | matchRegex. Default contains.

clickUrlValue.description: Scope a click trigger by {{Click URL}}, e.g. "mailto:" or "tel:".

eventName.description: For kind "custom_event": the dataLayer event name, e.g. "generate_lead".

formIdOperator.description: equals | contains | startsWith | endsWith | matchRegex. Default equals.

formIdValue.description: For kind "form_submit": scope to one form by {{Form ID}}.

intervalMs.description: For kind "timer": firing interval in milliseconds. REQUIRED for timer.

kind.description: pageview | link_click | all_clicks | form_submit | custom_event | dom_ready | window_loaded | history_change | scroll_depth | element_visibility | youtube_video | js_error | timer. Use link_click for <a> clicks (outbound links, downloads, mailto:, tel:) and all_clicks for any element.

limit.description: For kind "timer": how many times it may fire.

name.description: Trigger name. An existing trigger with this name is REUSED, not duplicated.

pageHostnameOperator.description: equals | contains | startsWith | endsWith | matchRegex. Default equals.

pageHostnameValue.description: Scope by {{Page Hostname}}. ANDed into the filter of any filter-capable kind.

pagePathValue.description: Scope to a page by {{Page Path}}.

pageUrlOperator.description: equals | contains | startsWith | endsWith | matchRegex. Default contains.

pageUrlValue.description: Scope by {{Page URL}}, e.g. a "?thanks=1" success page.

referrerOperator.description: equals | contains | startsWith | endsWith | matchRegex. Default contains.

referrerValue.description: Scope by {{Referrer}}. ANDed into the filter of any filter-capable kind.

scrollHorizontalPercentages.description: For kind "scroll_depth": horizontal percent thresholds. Off unless supplied.

scrollPercentages.description: For kind "scroll_depth": vertical percent thresholds, e.g. "25, 50, 75, 90". This is the default.

scrollPixels.description: For kind "scroll_depth": vertical PIXEL thresholds instead of percentages.

visibilityElementId.description: For kind "element_visibility": the element's id attribute, as an alternative to visibilitySelector.

visibilityFiringFrequency.description: For kind "element_visibility": ONCE | ONCE_PER_ELEMENT | MANY_PER_ELEMENT. Default ONCE.

visibilityMinOnScreenMs.description: For kind "element_visibility": require the element to stay on screen for N milliseconds first.

visibilityMinPercent.description: For kind "element_visibility": minimum percent of the element on screen before it fires. Default 50.

visibilityObserveDomChanges.description: For kind "element_visibility": keep watching for elements added AFTER page load (an AJAX confirmation message). Default true.

visibilitySelector.description: For kind "element_visibility": CSS selector of the element to watch, e.g. "#gform_confirmation_message". REQUIRED unless visibilityElementId is given.

name: create_gtm_tracking_tag
